Resetting your password

If you forgot your password, you can reset it from the sign in page. Open the sign in page, choose the link under the password field and enter the email address you signed up with. A message with a reset link arrives within a few minutes, and the link stays valid for one hour.

Open the link on the same device where you want to sign in. Choose a new password that is at least twelve characters long and that you do not use anywhere else. Once you save it, every other session is signed out, so you may need to sign in again on your phone and on other computers.

If the message never arrives, check your spam folder and make sure the address is spelled correctly. Some company mail servers hold messages from new senders for a while. You can ask your administrator to allow our address, or email support and we will help.
